create_identity_embedding: create an IdentityEmbedding module that passes input tensors through unchanged with configurable group
create_ray_point_embedding: create a RayPointEmbedding module that composes multiple embeddings with iteration-based wait and stop scheduling
use_embedding_dict: use the embedding_dict registry to look up and instantiate embedding classes by string type key
set_embedding_iteration: set the current iteration on an embedding module to control which sub-embeddings are active
forward_ray_point_embedding: forward rays through a RayPointEmbedding to get flattened feature dictionaries with active embeddings applied
